name: IT team · a shell-only diff can never be verified — the mapping ignores .sh files and returns a vacuous `allow`
description:
Finding from the QA shift of 2026-11-23 while gating `2639c296` / `716c63f8` (demo/up.sh).

## The defect
`qa_review_changes` maps changed files to tests by source extension. A `.sh` file is **neither mapped to a test nor counted as an unmapped source**, so it is silently skipped and the verdict is `allow`:

```
qa_review_changes(paths=["codx-junior-installer/demo/up.sh"], scope="all", run_tests=false)
→ decision: allow | changed_files: 1 | test_files: 2 | mapped_sources: 0 | unmapped_sources: 0 | findings: 0
```

`changed_files: 1` with `mapped_sources: 0` + `unmapped_sources: 0` = the file was seen and then dropped. `allow` here is vacuous, not evidence.

## Why it matters here specifically
This project is **31 files, 0 symbols, all shell + markdown** (`project_health`, 2026-11-23). Its only tests are `tests/test_install.sh` and `demo/tests/test_up.sh`. So for every real change in this repo the QA gate's `allow` currently carries **zero information** — the worst possible failure mode for a quality gate, worse than a block, because an empty allow is invisible.

## Do
1. Reproduce with the command above (note: `paths` must be **git-root-relative**, i.e. prefixed `codx-junior-installer/` — that is `f3e1dd0c`, a separate fix).
2. Count `*.sh` (and any other non-mapped extension present in the repo) as a **source**: either map it to a test or report `change.missing-tests`. Never drop it silently.
3. Fail closed: a `changed_files > 0` diff with `mapped_sources == 0` must not be `allow` unless every changed path is in `qa_policy.ignore_paths` with a dated reason.

## Acceptance criteria
- `qa_review_changes(paths=["codx-junior-installer/demo/up.sh"], scope="all")` no longer returns `allow` while nothing executes; it returns `require_approval`/`block` naming the unmapped `.sh`.
- Once the `demo` suite is declared (defect 3, see `f3e1dd0c`), the same call executes `demo/tests/test_up.sh` and reports `tests_selected > 0`.
- A test proves the old behaviour (`.sh` dropped → `allow`) is gone.

## Out of scope
Do not add `demo/` to `qa_policy.ignore_paths` to make this go away — `demo/up.sh` is the M1 demo entry point. Do not change product code from this card; the gate lives in the platform tooling.

Discovered by the `qa` shift, 2026-11-23. Related: `f3e1dd0c` (path root), `716c63f8` (the harness that should be run), `d1ba037a` (suite declaration).
